text:
aisha: Proposal: SDKs emit a tiny routing hint header `X-RW-Routing: bucket=canary-3` behind opt-in env RD_ROUTING_HINT=enabled. This is to surface hint vs resolved routing in Console without changing payloads.

tom: Header sounds good. We must avoid underscores and keep it short. Ops: confirm proxies (nginx/ALB/istio) preserve custom headers.

matt: Telemetry plan: gateway records `route_hint` as an attribute and emits counters `sdk.hint.emitted` + `gateway.hint.resolved`. Sampling 0.5% for full traces.

ryn: SDK surface: helper methods (client.set_route_hint('canary-3')) rather than manual headers. Opt-in by env so no surprise to users. Add local metric if header emission fails.

aisha: Rollout: canary 2% tenants region-by-region, mirror traffic to staging first, then show Console tile behind feature flag.

tom: Edge case: multiple hints in a call chain -> gateway uses outermost and logs a conflict trace. Add acceptance tests.

infra-bot: CI queued: py-sdk-routehint-compat -> runs against nginx and istio containers.

matt: Also: quota billing remains on resolved route; Console shows hint as advisory. Add alert if >0.1% of billed tokens have mismatched hints.

aisha: Docs + migration checklist needed. I'll open RFC and link PRs for py/ts/go.

tom: Security: cap header length to 256 chars and sanitize before logging.

ryn: I'll draft SDK PRs tonight. Quick parity check: avoid header names with underscores per ALB issue.

aisha: Thanks. Action items: sdk PRs, gateway tests, metrics wiring, console tile behind flag, ops proxy sweep, docs. I'll track in RFC. :white_check_mark:
